title: Updating a pastry pickup order

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: I ordered six almond pastries for festival pickup. Can I switch two to plain? My younger sister prefers plain.
turns.zh: 我預訂了六個杏仁糕點，要在活動現場領取。可以把其中兩個改成原味嗎？我妹妹比較喜歡原味。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Sure. Four almond, two plain. They scan your receipt at pickup, so keep the original code.
turns.zh: 可以。四個杏仁、兩個原味。取貨時會掃描憑單，所以請留著原取貨碼。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: My older brother’s collecting it. How can he check they’ve given him the changed order?
turns.zh: 我哥哥會代領。他怎麼確認拿到的是改過的訂單？

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I’ll write the varieties and quantities on the seal. Have him check it before he leaves.
turns.zh: 我會把口味和各自數量寫在封條上。請他離開前核對。
